## Summary

**File:** `/Users/mdostal/Documents/work/personal/mdostal-tools-hub/scripts/crawl-github-repos.mjs`

**Fix 1 — list-item detection in `deriveDescriptionFromReadme`:**
- Added `LIST_ITEM` regex (line 111): `/^(?:[-*+]\s|\d+\.\s)/`
- In the "find start of first real paragraph" loop (line 127), added `if (LIST_ITEM.test(line)) continue;` so bullet/numbered list lines are skipped just like headings/rules/badges.
- In the paragraph-collection loop (lines 133–144), added a break when a list item is encountered mid-collection (`if (i > start && LIST_ITEM.test(line)) break;`) — needed because ClusterExample's README has a real prose sentence immediately followed by a bullet list with no blank line separator; without this, the sentence and the next bullet would still get concatenated.

**Fix 2 — description column in `printSummaryTable`:**
- Added `truncateForColumn(text, maxLength)` helper (line ~190) and a `DESCRIPTION_COLUMN_MAX_LENGTH = 60` constant.
- Added `"description"` to the `columns` array (line 196).
- In `main()`, initialized `row.description = ""` and set `row.description = truncateForColumn(description, DESCRIPTION_COLUMN_MAX_LENGTH)` right after a description is successfully derived (before the `mount`/id logic).

**ClusterExample description — before/after:**
- Before: `"- check your system with [KDoctor](https://github.com/Kotlin/kdoctor) - install JDK 17 or higher on your machine - add \`local.properties\` file to the project root and set a path to Android SDK there"` (garbled bullet concatenation)
- After: `"To run the application on android device/emulator:"` (a real sentence pulled from prose further down the README, past the list items)

**Regression check (live dry-run against real GitHub account):**
- `gigradar` → "Open-source gig radar: define your accounts, needs, and rol…"
- `human-review` → "Pantheon plugin: review dashboard UI for the approval plugi…"
- `rolodex` → "Your relationship rolodex as an MCP tool: own your contacts…"
- `coin-finder` → "Find my BTC and help me identify the wallets"

All four unchanged/sensible — no regression. Full dry-run scanned 27 repos, 13 suggested, table now shows the new `description` column truncated to ~60 chars.

**Lint:** `pnpm lint` → clean, exit code 0, no warnings/errors.
